**Étude is public to read, but not open to contributions.**

Thank you for the interest — genuinely. Code contributions can't be accepted:
the licence is proprietary and a CLA is more overhead than one person can
justify. This pull request will be closed unread, and that is not a judgement
on the work in it.

Bug reports, ideas and questions are very welcome, and they are what actually
moves the app: please open an [issue](https://github.com/benstreich/etude/issues)
instead.
